string.text: %c[ui_gray_1]Fair Fast Travel is replaced by %c[pda_yellow]True Fast Travel%c[ui_gray_1].\n \n%c[pda_white]See %c[pda_yellow]PDA Guide -> Addons -> True Fast Travel%c[pda_white].

%c[ui_gray_1]
%c[pda_yellow]True Fast Travel%c[ui_gray_1] walks you along the real path. You can cancel and reverse.

%c[pda_green]HOW TO TRAVEL
%c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]Open the PDA map and %c[pda_yellow]right-click%c[ui_gray_2] a base, campfire, or zone exit on the %c[pda_yellow]current map%c[ui_gray_2].
%c[pda_white]- %c[pda_yellow]Run to%c[ui_gray_2]: follow at run speed.
%c[pda_white]- %c[pda_yellow]Sneak to%c[ui_gray_2]: same path, crouched. Slower, easier to slip past hostiles.
%c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]Press %c[pda_yellow]Space%c[ui_gray_2] or %c[pda_yellow]Escape%c[ui_gray_2] to cancel.

%c[pda_green]DURING TRAVEL
%c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]Companions rejoin you when the trip ends.
%c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]Cancel or combat starts a slow reverse. An emission stops you at once.
%c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]You cannot start during an emission, with hostiles too close, or when you cannot walk.

%c[pda_green]AMBUSHES
%c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]Hostiles along the path can stop you. Sneak travel is more likely to slip past.

%c[pda_white]Good luck stalker...
